settings.title: Home Design
settings.description: Configure content width, desktop top nav, and footer business notice for official sirsoft-basic.

fields.hide_desktop_top_nav_hint: Hides Header board/home/shop tab nav via CSS (official theme compatible).
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_json: Board slugs to hide in header (JSON array)
fields.hide_header_board_slugs_json_hint: e.g. ["qna", "inquiry"] — same default as feat theme.
fields.footer_link_groups_json_hint: JSON array of {title, links:[{label,href}]} — empty uses theme default linkGroups; when set, replaces Footer props.linkGroups entirely. Prefer FAQ href /faq (feat) over official /page/faq. See textarea placeholder for an example.
fields.business_info_enabled_hint: Shows business info from ecommerce basic settings
